name: Sono Koi wa Zettai Kanawanai
original_name: その恋は絶対叶わない
source:
My childhood friend is gay. It seems that buff guys are his type.
I, on the other hand, like pretty boys with slender bodies. He and I will probably never understand each other.
......Well, it doesn't matter.
The scary part is that the guy he likes is my older brother. Give me a break.
Every day, he comes to my room asking for love advice. Seriously, make it stop!!
This is so dumb... It's not like this love will ever bear fruit.

[Translated from [url=https://www.freem.ne.jp/win/game/24479]Freem![/url]]
